files.content: "use client" import { useId } from "react" import { CartesianGrid, Scatter, ScatterChart as RechartsScatterChart, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts" import { ChartContainer, ChartTooltipContent, type ChartConfig } from "@/components/ui/chart" export type ScatterChartDatum = { key: string; label: string; x: number; y: number } export type ScatterChartProps = { data: readonly [ScatterChartDatum, ...ScatterChartDatum[]]; label: string; xLabel: string; yLabel: string; height?: number } export function ScatterChart({ data, label, xLabel, yLabel, height = 240 }: ScatterChartProps) { const id = useId() const config: ChartConfig = { points: { label, color: "var(--chart-1)" } } return }
